title: Negative fixture: p95 above p99
description: MUST be rejected. The latency model is a quantile parameterisation, so a non-monotone triple is not an unusual distribution, it is an unsatisfiable one: the fitted body and tail would cross and the sampler would produce negative latencies. Copy-pasting a row into a new acquirer is how this happens in practice, which is why it is a check and not a comment.
